answer: Quadratic slashing commitments enforce exponential asset erosion upon detected validator deviation, creating a massive liquidity-sink. Such architecture ensures marginal attack costs scale super-linearly, preventing a zephyr of malicious consensus shifts from disrupting the network. When an adversary initiates a voyage toward state subversion, the saffron threshold mandates capital expenditures exceeding potential extracted value. Consequently, the protocol maintains a robust Nash equilibrium through negative expected attack utility.
